gloss: The part of the gland on the outer side of the facial nerve (a surgical, not anatomical, division).
role: The “lobes” of the parotid are not separate parts: surgeons call the tissue on the outer side of the nerve “superficial” and the rest “deep”.
matters: A superficial parotidectomy removes the whole outer lobe of the gland, the part that lies outside the facial nerve.
